display.purpose: The Exhale wordmark on the home screen. One instance per app.

headline.purpose: Screen titles such as Practice and Complete.

title.purpose: Active phase and Beginning in labels. Semibold, large, low tracking, and shadowed for phone readability.

body.purpose: Taglines, descriptions, helper rows, policy copy, and completion quotes.

label.purpose: Button text, metadata, stat labels, tabs, and compact controls.

timer.purpose: Countdown during active sessions. Tabular numerals prevent layout shift.

shadows.name: phase-label-text-edge
shadows.purpose: Text-over-canvas legibility for active phase labels. Not structural elevation.

shadows.name: phase-instruction-text-edge
shadows.purpose: Text-over-canvas legibility for active instruction sentences. Not structural elevation.

shadows.name: local-hud-halo
shadows.value: blurred forest-night/40 oval behind phase text
shadows.purpose: Low-vision phone readability over bright phase colors without introducing a card.

motion.name: ease-phase-crossfade
motion.purpose: Phase label and instruction boundary crossfade.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Buttons, tabs, setup controls, and selected states.

motion.name: orb-breathe
motion.purpose: Static orb mark on home and Practice when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: settling-sequence
motion.value: 7.8s fade sequence before guided session starts at 8s
motion.purpose: Lets the user arrive before the first guided inhale.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Widens home wordmark tracking, increases title scale, and shows desktop keyboard hints.

breakpoints.name: small-canvas
breakpoints.purpose: BreathingOrb reduces particle count on small viewports for mobile performance.

components.name: Begin Button
components.description: Primary home action. The only solid emerald action on the first screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-begin { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #34d399; background: #34d399; color: #0f1712; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, transform 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-begin:hover { background: #a7f3d0; border-color: #a7f3d0; } .ds-btn-begin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(167,243,208,0.85); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-begin:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action for Practice history, Back, Back to Menu, and subdued navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.18); background: transparent; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.58); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease, transform 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(245,245,242,0.05); border-color: rgba(245,245,242,0.30); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.75); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(167,243,208,0.85); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Session Length Option
components.description: First decision surface. Two by two on mobile, four columns on wider screens. Time label only.
components.css: .ds-session-option { min-height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.26); background: transparent; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.80); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 200; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease; } .ds-session-option:hover { border-color: rgba(245,245,242,0.40); background: rgba(245,245,242,0.05); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.92); } .ds-session-option--selected { border-color: rgba(52,211,153,0.60); background: rgba(52,211,153,0.10); color: rgba(209,250,229,0.90); } .ds-session-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(167,243,208,0.85); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Session Setup Tab
components.description: Segmented tab inside the post-first-session setup drawer.
components.css: .ds-setup-tab { min-height: 44px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.60); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease; } .ds-setup-tab:hover { border-color: rgba(245,245,242,0.18); background: rgba(245,245,242,0.05); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.80); } .ds-setup-tab--active { border-color: rgba(52,211,153,0.60); background: rgba(52,211,153,0.10); color: rgba(209,250,229,0.90); } .ds-setup-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(167,243,208,0.85); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sound Tile
components.description: Compact sound palette option. Selected state matches Time, Pace, and Circle Size.
components.css: .ds-sound-tile { min-height: 44px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.16); background: transparent; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.58); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; transition: background 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease; } .ds-sound-tile:hover { border-color: rgba(245,245,242,0.30); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.78); } .ds-sound-tile--selected { border-color: rgba(52,211,153,0.60); background: rgba(52,211,153,0.10); color: rgba(209,250,229,0.90); } .ds-sound-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(236,253,245,0.95); }

components.name: Game Control Button
components.description: Pause and Exit controls during active sessions. Bottom corners, compact radius, 44px touch target.
components.css: .ds-game-control { min-width: 80px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.22); background: transparent; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.72); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease; } .ds-game-control:hover { border-color: rgba(245,245,242,0.38); background: rgba(245,245,242,0.05); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.92); } .ds-game-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(167,243,208,0.85); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Phase HUD Text
components.description: Active-session phase label and instruction over the breathing canvas.
components.html:
Inhale

Breathe in slowly through your nose
components.css: .ds-phase-hud { position: relative; width: min(28rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); text-align: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f5f5f2; } .ds-phase-halo { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: min(25rem, 92vw); height: 10rem; transform: translate(-50%, -57%); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(15,23,18,0.40); filter: blur(32px); pointer-events: none; } .ds-phase-title { position: relative; margin: 0; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.92); text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(8,14,10,1), 0 5px 20px rgba(8,14,10,0.92), 0 0 30px rgba(8,14,10,0.58); } .ds-phase-instruction { position: relative; margin: 6px auto 0; max-width: 18rem; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.86); text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(8,14,10,0.98), 0 4px 18px rgba(8,14,10,0.88), 0 0 26px rgba(8,14,10,0.54); }

components.name: Orb Mark
components.description: Static Exhale mark for home, Practice, policy, and completion contexts. It has intrinsic light but no box-shadow glow.
components.css: .ds-orb-mark { position: relative; width: 80px; height: 80px; animation: ds-orb-breathe 8s ease-in-out infinite; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-orb-mark { animation: none; } } @keyframes ds-orb-breathe { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.14); } } .ds-orb-core { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%, rgba(202,224,211,0.68) 0%, rgba(94,158,118,0.60) 46%, rgba(31,82,52,0.64) 100%); } .ds-orb-highlight { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,245,242,0.14) 0%, rgba(245,245,242,0) 56%); } .ds-orb-ring { position: absolute; inset: -14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(93,177,132,0.20); }

components.name: Stats Row
components.description: Flat Practice history row. No card, no side stripe, no pressure framing.
components.css: .ds-stats-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.10); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stats-label { color: rgba(245,245,242,0.58); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stats-value { color: rgba(245,245,242,0.86); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 200; }

Sign In

components.css: .ds-signin { width: 100%; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.10); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-signin-label { margin: 0 0 12px; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.58); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-signin-copy { margin: 0 0 12px; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.58); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-signin-button { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.18); background: rgba(245,245,242,0.03); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.72); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease; } .ds-signin-button:hover { border-color: rgba(245,245,242,0.30); background: rgba(245,245,242,0.06); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.86); } .ds-signin-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(167,243,208,0.85); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Exhale is a surface that reflects without distorting. It moves with the user but never against them: responsive to breath, invisible to anxiety. The design holds itself at rest: near-black ground, a single soft orb, text that barely whispers. Nothing competes for attention because the breath is the only thing that matters.

The brand personality is quiet, warm, accessible. The system's restraint is deliberate. The primary user has never opened a self-care app and will leave at the first sign of obligation. Every visual decision is filtered through one test: does this create friction, or does it dissolve it? Borders are present only to help the eye, not to impose structure. Color shifts with the breath cycle, teaching the rhythm without a word of instruction. Silence is not absence. It is the point.

This system explicitly rejects the language of productivity apps, the visual cliches of wellness software, the branded exuberance of Headspace and Calm, and anything that requires the user to understand a concept before they can breathe.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with a warm forest glow that anchors without darkening
A single emerald accent, used sparingly; amber appears only at session close
Inter at extralight and light weights, airy but not too thin to read
Wide tracking on uppercase labels; sentence case for human-facing copy
Motion follows breath rhythm; nothing decorates for its own sake
Flat surfaces, no structural shadows; depth comes through glow and opacity
Session controls sit in the thumb zone at the bottom corners
Low-vision readability is part of calm

rules.name: The Amber Exception Rule
rules.body: Amber appears on one screen, for one purpose: session closure. If you are tempted to use amber anywhere else, the answer is no.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Emerald is the only accent. Phase colors belong to the canvas, not the UI. Do not use phase colors for buttons, labels, borders, or overlays outside of the session canvas.

rules.name: The Weight Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Semibold (600) is reserved for the active phase label, the Beginning in pre-session label, and the Begin button label. Every other element uses 100, 200, or 300.

rules.name: The Uppercase Contract
rules.body: Uppercase is for labels and controls only. Copy is always sentence case.

rules.name: The Text Opacity Floor
rules.body: Content text uses Still White at 55% opacity or higher. Lower opacities are reserved for structural and decorative chrome only.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No UI element uses box-shadow for structural depth. If you reach for a drop shadow to separate a card, panel, or modal from the background, rethink the structure instead.

dos: Do keep emerald (#34d399) at <=10% surface coverage on any screen outside the active session canvas.
Do use opacity as the primary tool for hierarchy.
Do apply wide tracking (0.18em minimum) to uppercase labels.
Do use amber (#fbbf24) exclusively on the session complete screen.
Do keep all button text at font-light (300) or lighter, uppercase, with tracking >=0.18em. The Begin button is the one sanctioned exception.
Do surface stats and practice history as optional, secondary navigation.
Do keep Sign In optional and quiet.
Do keep active-session phase and instruction text readable for older and low-vision phone users.
Do place session controls (Pause, Exit) in the bottom corners of the session screen.
donts: Don't use font-bold, font-extrabold, font-normal, or any weight other than 100, 200, 300, or 600.
Don't add shadows for structural elevation.
Don't use a colored overlay for dialog or guard backdrops.
Don't add a second accent color.
Don't use italic anywhere in the interface.
Don't design like Headspace or Calm.
Don't design like a fitness app.
Don't require an account, login, OAuth, or cloud sync before breathing.
Don't build a full account surface around Google sign-in.
Don't make a future admin panel look like generic SaaS.
Don't add push notifications, sharing features, or social comparisons.
